claude_proposed_widenings.name: evasion_save_outcome
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Evasion changes the success/failure outcome semantics for a specific class of effects (Dex save, succeed = half damage): success → 0 damage, failure → half damage. No existing atom modifies save outcome semantics. modify_roll_advantage changes the roll; grant_resistance halves damage broadly; grant_damage_immunity is type-scoped. None of these express 'when you succeed a Dex save that would normally deal half damage, you take 0 instead; when you fail, you take half.'
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail.
